system.description:
You gain the [Nature] tag. Add + (INT Mod) to your [Recovery].

(Effect): Secondary targets within a range of [Targets: [SR] / Range: 4Sq.] centered on you must make a [Safe Move (forced)] up to 2 Sq.

A special skill that summons and employs myconids, ancestral spirits that embody the diversity of nature. A swarm of charming mushroom spirits scoops at the target's feet and sweeps them away at will.
